name: Allspring Ultra Short Municipal ETF
desc: Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the fund’s net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in municipal securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax, but not necessarily federal alternative minimum tax (AMT); up to 20% of the fund’s total assets in securities whose interest is subject to federal AMT; and up to 10% of the fund’s total assets in below investment-grade municipal securities.
